title: MemberRegistered
description: The `MemberRegistered` interface: member ID, name, email and joined at, as `MemberService.register` saves it.

title: ToolAdded
description: The `ToolAdded` interface: tool ID, name, description (empty when none) and added at, as `ToolService.add` saves it.

title: DamageReported
description: The `DamageReported` interface: tool ID, note and reported at, as `ToolService.reportDamage` saves it. The time is the event's; the tools table keeps only the note.

title: ToolRepaired
description: The `ToolRepaired` interface: tool ID and repaired at, as `ToolService.markRepaired` saves it.

title: LoanOpened
description: The `LoanOpened` interface: loan ID, member, tool, borrowed at and due date, as `LendingService.borrow` saves it.

title: ToolReturned
description: The `ToolReturned` interface: loan ID, member, tool, returned at, condition, note (null when none) and late, as `LendingService.return` saves it. TL-LEND-PO01 hears it, so it must go by outbox. `Outbox`, in the same file, saves every event to the `outbox` table of `src/store.ts` (`saveEvent`) in its command's transaction; its `relay` hands each undelivered event, oldest first, to the handlers subscribed to it after commit and marks it delivered (`nextUndeliveredEvent`, `markEventDelivered`). An event whose handler fails stays undelivered for the next run.
